title: Course Schedule II
description: Find an ordering of courses to finish all, given prerequisites using Kahn's algorithm (BFS).
pseudocode:
1. Build adjacency list and calculate in-degree of all nodes
2. Add nodes with in-degree 0 to queue
3. While queue is not empty:
4. Pop node u, add to result list
5. For each neighbor v of u: decrement in-degree
6. If in-degree of v is 0, add to queue

steps.note: Queue initialized with nodes having 0 in-degree: [0]
No more nodes with 0 in-degree. Process ends.
